label: Film Camera
instructions: Resolve shot scale first: close-up, upper body, cowboy shot, full body, wide shot.
Then resolve angle and spatial layer: from above/from below/eye level, foreground/background, depth of field.
Add light direction only when visible: rim light, backlighting, soft light, moonlight, candlelight, neon lighting.
Use concise photographic tag vocabulary; do not write prose storyboards.
